name: change control board
normative-structure: A baselined thing changes because this office decided it should, and by no other route. It persists across incumbents because the alternative does: where a baseline can be changed by whoever is currently editing it, the baseline records what the last person did rather than what the firm agreed, and every downstream reader is trusting a number nobody chose. The office is cross-functional and commercially weighted on purpose — a change is a business decision wearing a technical shape, and a board drawn only from the building line will price a change at what it costs to make rather than at what it costs everyone else. It decides; it does not record its own decisions, and it does not make the changes it approves.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: Huawei's change control board (变更控制委员会) is chaired by the product development team leader and carries representation from R&D, market, procurement, manufacturing, quality, and finance — cross-functional and business-weighted, and this composition is the genuine Huawei tell

huidu-guanli/ipd: this board is a CHANGE control board and is not the configuration control board of the 系统集成项目管理工程师 certification syllabus, whose four-role model and duty lists are evidence about a Chinese IT exam and not about any firm — the conflation is why most circulating accounts of this office are worthless

huidu-guanli/ipd: an approved change is recorded by the configuration management officer (配置管理员), so deciding and recording are held apart and a change that reached a baseline without this office reached it around the record
huidu-guanli: 法 binds the senior as well as the junior — a board whose chair can quietly exempt a change is not this office, it is the appearance of one
unrealized: the cross-functional representation this office's whole structure rests on does not exist as seated offices, so the board is presently its chair alone — which is the failure mode the composition exists to prevent, and it is seated in that state knowingly
no scripted act proposes a change to this office or records its decision, so nothing prevents a change reaching a baseline around it
